source: The Ordo 2025-2026, compiled by Peter Day-Milne, copyright The Latin Mass Society 2025 (https://lms.org.uk). Facts only: the days, dates, classes and colours of the dioceses of Wales, taken by hand; the names are in Missalemeum's style. Feasts of single dioceses are left out.

occasions.name: St. Thomas of Canterbury, Bishop & Martyr
occasions.note: 29 December 2025: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Thomas of Canterbury B M, I Cl, R. Replaces the universal commemoration of St Thomas Becket.

occasions.name: St. David, Bishop & Confessor, Patron of Wales
occasions.note: 2 March 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, St David B C, I Cl, W, moved from 1 March, the Second Sunday of Lent.

occasions.name: St. George, Martyr
occasions.note: 23 April 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, St George M, III Cl, R. Universally a commemoration.

occasions.name: Holy Martyrs of England & Wales
occasions.note: 4 May 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, The Holy Martyrs of England and Wales, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: St. Ubaldus
occasions.note: 16 May 2026: St Ubaldus B C, III Cl, W, on the Ordo's main line. Missalemeum has a commemoration.

occasions.name: St. Alban, Martyr
occasions.note: 22 June 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Alban M, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: Sts. John Fisher, Bishop, & Thomas More, Martyrs
occasions.note: 9 July 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, SS John Fisher B & Thomas More MM, I Cl, R.

occasions.name: Our Lady in Porticu
occasions.note: 17 July 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, Our Lady in Porticu, III Cl, W.

occasions.name: Bl. Edward Powell, Richard Featherstone & Companions, Martyrs
occasions.note: 30 July 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, BB Edward Powell, Richard Featherstone & Comps MM, III Cl, R.

occasions.name: St. Germanus, Bishop & Confessor
occasions.note: 3 August 2026: In both dioceses of Wales, St Germanus B C, III Cl, W.

occasions.name: St. Edward the Confessor, King
occasions.note: 13 October 2026: In all dioceses of England and Wales, St Edward K C, II Cl, W. Universally III Cl.

occasions.name: St. Didacus
occasions.note: 13 November 2026: St Didacus C, III Cl, W, on the Ordo's main line. Missalemeum has a commemoration.
